study: Frequency sensitivity of the frozen local Guosheng model, not selection of new parameters
weekly: First actual exchange session in each Monday-Sunday week
daily: Recompute target each exchange session; fresh target supersedes any previous refill
switch: Check daily, trigger only on changed basket in addition to scheduled reweights
frozen: Same asset universe, signal, previous-session cutoff, 63-day covariance, 500000 yuan, 1.5bp commission min 5, sell proceeds convention
other_controls: 9bp previous-session sale funds versus same-day sale funds in the recent real-ETF quote model. Measure different targets and realized costs, not frequency alone.
